en.answer: If <<11648>> battles, as long as it destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, its effect can be activated during either player's turn.
en.question: Can the effect of <<11648>> which adds a "Change" Quick-Play Spell Card from the Deck to the hand be activated during either player's turn?
